notes.title: V640 major revision phase 1 - update instructions
notes.notes:
[b][V640 revision first phase - updated content][/b]

*Remove the restriction that only one account can log in to the server with the same IP at the same time.

*Reduce the blood deduction speed for injuries in the rest area to 1/10.

*The experience points required to upgrade all levels after level 100 are reduced to the same experience points required to upgrade level 100 to level 101.

*Crime system modifications -

  Assault on an offender will result in a misdemeanor.
  Knocking down the criminal will result in a guilty verdict.


  PS: As long as you attack other players, the other players will definitely be able to counterattack.
  PS: The criminal can be taught a lesson, but killing the criminal is still a crime.


*Knocking down a player will increase your reputation by 10 times.
  (If the target citizen level is lower than yourself, it will only be increased by 2 times. If the target is knocked down continuously in a short period of time, it will be 0)

*Remove the restriction that offenders and their partners cannot have orgasms.

*Reduce the price of card gift bags by half.

*Modify the rest area to allow oral sex and masturbation.


*Except for the existing high-level maps that have a small fixed monster regeneration area where you can practice with dogs for a long time.
  A new small-scale fixed monster citizen regeneration point has been added to the general urban map.
  (Each map has 2 locations, low-level monsters and high-level monsters. Mainly distributed near railings or water pipes.)

*The ability value of all summoned dogs is increased by 2 times.
  (attack, defense, vitality)

*Modify that the little yellow dog will not pick up props with a price lower than 500.



*Significantly increase the prices of advanced materials (gems) and advanced trap materials (C4, gas cans, etc.).
  (Paired with yellow dog pickup restrictions.)

*Remove the restriction that requires more than half physical strength to perform skills and actions.
  You can execute it as long as you have enough physical strength to activate the skill.


*Fix some graphics card screen lag issues.

*Fix the problem of abnormal position when the window appears.

*Fixed an issue that caused catl and shift to become invalid in some input methods.

*The server structure has been upgraded to 128 bits. Fixed the phenomenon of characters stuck (flying) on ​​the map caused by floating point operation exception.

none

notes.title: Version V610 update
notes.notes:
[b][V610 Version Update Instructions][/b]

The V610 version is mainly for the feedback on the balance adjustment of the battle royale in Tokyo in the past year.
In addition, two new systems have been added - blood loss system and tax coin system.

Injured Blood Loss System The blood spurting effect of the character's injury finally has real meaning.
Don't knock down the opponent, watch the opponent lose blood to death in cold blood.
After the addition of the injury system and the coma system, the real battle royale is about to begin.

The tax coin system is a system planned for the long-term operation of the game and the balance of payments.
Because it is not mandatory, except for players who want to earn cash by trading gold bars in the game, ordinary players will not be affected at all.
And because the number of people online in the game is not large enough, the effect on operating income is not significant. It is only a symbolic system.

The tax coin system exists only to inform the general public that -

[i][This MMO virtual world without a stored value system still has income plans, so don’t worry about the server not being able to maintain it] :P[/i]


In addition, the character CG system that was originally expected to be launched will be changed to match the Steam card system.
Allows players to collect character CG cards, and freely trade various character CG cards. To activate the game community and trade.

However, the Steam platform stipulates that the game must be sold to a certain amount before the card system can be activated.
We still have to wait until the card system of Doomsday Battle Royale is opened before the character CG system can be opened at the same time.

The focus of the next revision will be on the enhancement of the MOD system and the enhancement of the AI system.
Since it has nothing to do with the balance of the game, we expect it to be launched in two months. Looking forward to the card system being launched at the same time.


[hr][/hr]

[V610 version update content]

* When removing a trap, if the removal is successful,
  There is a 1/2 chance to retrieve the installed trap itself.

*In addition to the mutation map and the Sanctuary Golden Palace, special maps have added resources.
  (Chinatown, Tunnel, Sanctuary, etc.)

*When shooting guns, all players on the same map will hear gunshots.

* Mutation Seeds have a 10-times longer duration.

*The fixed-point camouflage duration is extended by 3 times.

*Throwing and shooting down and precision shooting down skills strengthen the force by 3 times.

*The price of the pass for the automated police station has been adjusted to 5 times.

* Cancel the setting that you cannot get the skill book of the enemy faction when hunting monsters.

* Added injured blood loss system -

When a character is injured, the vitality will gradually and slowly drain.
The more serious the injury, the faster the loss rate.

Sitting down reduces the drain rate by 1/2, and lying down reduces it to 1/4.
Walking will increase the loss rate by 2 times, and running will increase by 4 times.

(In the state of minor injuries, when the character sits down, it takes about 1 hour to drain from full capacity to 0 HP.)

When the character loses too much life and the health drops below half.
There is a very low chance that the injury will worsen.

Sitting down reduces the rate of deterioration by 1/2, and lying down reduces it to 1/4.
Walking will increase the chance of deterioration by 2 times, and running will increase it by 4 times.
When the vitality drops below 1000, the chance of aggravating injuries will increase greatly.

When the injury deteriorates to serious injury and the last drop of blood is lost,

The character will die...


* Added tax gold coin - gold bar transaction fee.

When players exchange gold coins for gold bars,
The extra gold coins that were originally required to be collected have been changed to tax gold coins.

(There is no additional charge for converting gold bars back into coins.)

Tax coins can be inquired and purchased in the member center-

If players do not need to convert gold coins into gold bars for cash transactions,
There is no transaction fee required.


* Added brain piercing sound wave and slow sound wave attack will cancel the target's reincarnation attribute bonus.
(You can use skills such as self-mutilation and refreshing to remove the sonic state recovery bonus)

(PS: When people from different factions fight, they have the ability to cancel the opponent's reincarnation bonus. But the opponent can counteract it)


*Criminals (medium, heavy) cannot get reincarnation attribute bonus.
(The crime will not have an immediate effect, it will take effect after about 1 minute)

(PS: The reincarnated person can still take off his clothes to kill, but after 1 minute, he must cleanse himself before he can continue)

*Modify the casting time of the undressing skill to 1/2.
  When the skill level is 10, there is a chance to take off the target's underwear. Become half naked or fully naked.

*Modify the price of the New Year's Lucky Bag at the New Year's Shrine to increase by 2 times.

*Modified password can only be sent to friends,
  And the other party's friend list must have yourself.

* After modifying back to the character level exceeding level 100,
  The experience value required for upgrading increases with the level growth.

*Modify the GPS transmitter and cannot pass in the novice map.

*The fee for high-level citizens returning to the rest area early in the urban area is changed to 5000

*Modified encyclopedia synthesis data displayed in the dialog
  Fixed text errors displayed in encyclopedias in other languages.

*Fixed the bug that the skills required in the item description were incorrectly displayed.

*Fixed the bug that the citizen monster - Diva would disappear.
